content:
Looking for new iPhone and iPad games to play? The App Store has plenty of games with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is a good family subscription option, but it's not the only one. If you're already a Netflix subscriber, your monthly fee actually includes a massive library of great iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription includes a massive library of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription plan includes a massive library of mobile and TV games.

This includes the most affordable "Standard with ads" plan at just $8.99 per month.

No matter which Netflix plan you choose, you can play mobile and TV games for free, with no ads, no in-app purchases, and no extra fees.

If you want to play TV games, Netflix offers a dedicated iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Game Controller.

This app can turn your phone or tablet into a game controller to play games on supported Netflix smart TV apps. If you want to seriously upgrade your mobile gaming experience, buying a dedicated iPhone controller is a better option.

Netflix also has another iPhone and iPad app designed specifically for kids called Netflix Playground, which offers various mini-games. In addition, there's Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (playable without a subscription) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond the games mentioned above, Netflix supports over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store, then sign in with your Netflix email and password to play.
